title: Investigations into Whether Singaporeans Served in Israeli Defence Forces
what_it_is: Investigations into Whether Singaporeans Served in Israeli Defence Forces

sections.label: Singaporeans in foreign armed conflicts
sections.summary: The Ministry says it has no substantiated information on Singaporeans in the IDF, and Singaporeans should not join foreign armed conflicts.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The Ministry has no substantiated information confirming that any Singaporean has served, or is serving, in the IDF.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Our position has always been quite clear and publicly stated: Singaporeans should not participate in any foreign armed conflict not involving Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If Singaporeans are found to be fighting or even planning to fight in foreign armed conflicts, these persons will be dealt with sternly in accordance with our laws.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: And they can be dealt with under the Internal Security Act if they are found to be a threat to our national security.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Those found holding multiple citizenships may also be deprived of their Singapore citizenship.

sections.label: Offence under Singapore law
sections.summary: The conduct is an offence under Singapore law and contrary to national interests, but may not be an offence in Israel or elsewhere.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Because while it is an offence under Singapore law and we consider it to be contrary to our national interests, it may not be an offence in Israel, nor may it be an offence in other countries.

sections.label: Reaching out for information
sections.summary: Getting information may be difficult, no response has been received, and action will be taken on credible information regardless of the conflict.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: And if so, then there will be difficulties in getting the information – not just by the Israeli government, but other governments too.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: But we have reached out, we have not gotten a response.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If we get any credible information, we will take action.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: It does not matter to us whether you are fighting for Israel or Ukraine or Russia or some other Middle Eastern country or a terrorist organisation.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: It is not acceptable and we will take action if we find you.
